columns.name: JA_NOTIF_CONFIG_ID
columns.description: Primary key for the table. System generated.

columns.name: STEP_ACTION_USAGE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key IRC_STEP_ACTION_USAGES_B table. (Life cycle action context)

columns.name: NOTIFY_RECRUITER_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that captures if Notification is enable for Recruiter

columns.name: NOTIFY_HIRING_MGR_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that captures if Notification is enable for Hiring Manager

columns.name: INT_CAND_NOTIF_TMPL_ID
columns.description: Email template that is to be used for Internal candidate automatic notifications. Foreign key IRC_DESCRIPTIONS_B.DESCRIPTION_ID

columns.name: EXT_CAND_NOTIF_TMPL_ID
columns.description: Email template that is to be used for External candidate automatic notifications. Foreign key IRC_DESCRIPTIONS_B.DESCRIPTION_ID

columns.name: CANDIDATE_NOTIF_DELAY
columns.description: Stores the delay time in hours before sending notification to the candidate.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
